summary: Iteration 19 backend-only tests: verified calendar total_load now uses ADJUSTED load (base * session_multiplier), new total_load_base field exposed, team multipliers flow into calendar, and POST /api/teams now enforces the same session_multipliers validation as PUT (400 on invalid). 11/13 tests pass. The 2 failing tests are a pre-existing regression in team/athlete full-report PDFs (broken image data in reportlab) that also failed in iteration 18 — NOT caused by this iteration's changes.

critical.issue: Returns 500 - reportlab OSError: 'broken data stream when reading image file' when rendering team logo in _build_team_cover_pdf (server.py:4125). The Image() try/except only catches construction; the failure happens later at drawImage->PIL Image.load(). Pre-existing (also failing in iter18). Suggested fix: eagerly PIL.Image.open(bytes).load()/verify() and fall back to placeholder Drawing if invalid.
Returns 500 - same reportlab broken image data stream via team cover path. Pre-existing regression.

action_items: Fix broken team logo handling in _build_team_cover_pdf (~server.py:4123-4128): validate the base64-decoded image bytes with PIL (Image.open(...).verify() or .load()) inside the try block so corrupt logos fall back to the placeholder Drawing instead of failing later during drawImage(). This affects BOTH /api/export/team/full-report.pdf and /api/export/athlete/{id}/full-report.pdf.
critical_code_review_comments: The lazy-load nature of reportlab.platypus.Image means a corrupt image only errors at draw time, bypassing the try/except at construction. Always pre-validate image bytes.
Weekly/monthly athlete PDF exports work fine (200 + %PDF header) — issue is specific to the team cover path.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up TEST_iter19_valid and TEST_iter19_no_mult teams during POST parity tests. Reset team session_multipliers back to defaults {training:1.0,match:1.2,gym:1.0,recovery:0.7}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 change (calendar adjusted total_load + POST parity for multipliers) is verified working. The team/athlete full-report PDF 500 is a pre-existing bug from at least iter18 — a corrupt team logo blob in Mongo causes reportlab drawImage to raise. Weekly/monthly athlete PDFs are unaffected.
rca of the issue: server.py:4125 constructs reportlab Image() from base64 logo bytes wrapped in try/except, but reportlab defers actual image decoding until draw time, so a corrupt/invalid logo escapes the try block and crashes deep inside PIL Image.load() with 'broken data stream when reading image file'. Reproduce: GET /api/export/team/full-report.pdf as coach treinador@futsal.pt -> 500. Mitigation: replace `logo = Image(BytesIO(bytes), ...)` with an eager PIL validation, e.g. `im = PIL.Image.open(BytesIO(bytes)); im.load()` (or `.verify()`), then re-open into reportlab Image; on any exception fall back to the placeholder Drawing already coded on line 4130.
